title: FIMEI 12-Cup Food Processor and Vegetable Chopper, 600W Electric Food Chopper for Slicing, Shredding, Chopping, Pureeing, Dough, Baby Food Maker, Large Feed Chute, Dishwasher Safe Bowl
reviews: Haven’t used it very much yet but it is very easy to operate. Bended my food just as I intended it done. Well worth what I paid for.
Very nice food processor. Poor directions tho. I did not know to turn blade over for another type of processing. Now that I know, I enjoy it much more.
This is the best home chopped period. Look no further. Durable, powerful, easy to clean. It checks every box
It works great love it it’s light to move around
Fantastic quality. Not overly loud. Easy to use.

I have only used this once and it did slice and chop nicely. My complaint is the way it was packed. I had a hard time getting it put of the box. Got it put about 3" to find something was loose and holding it in the box. I stuck my hand in to try and push it back, only to cut my thumb on the chopping blade. Cut was deep enough that it took a while to stop the bleeding. There was a protective cover on the blade but it had come off. Why this was not in with the rest of the parts is beyond me! So buyers beware!
